result.notes: Ramp's Developer API is REST/OAuth2 (client credentials + authorization code, bearer tokens). Primary quickstart explicitly requires being an existing Ramp business customer with dashboard admin access to create a developer app ('This guide assumes you are a Ramp customer with admin access to your dashboard.'); a sandbox is available for testing, but production access requires a review/approval process ('Approval is required before production access.'). Third-party integrations for other businesses go through the separate Technology Partner Program (contact form, tiered access), which is more partner_gated in nature. No official vendor MCP server found; only community registry hits (e.g. com.mcparmory/ramp). Endpoint count/api_breadth estimated as medium based on resource coverage (transactions, cards, users, bills, reimbursements, accounting, limits, etc.) seen in docs navigation — not confirmed via a full OpenAPI spec count due to fetch budget.
result.one_liner: Ramp is a corporate card and spend-management platform offering a REST Developer API (OAuth2) for transactions, cards, users, bills, and accounting data.
